title: Agent summary parent and child links are not subject-tree constrained
description: Agent summary creation validates that parent/child summary IDs exist, and doctor checks dangling references, but neither path verifies that linked summaries belong to the same subject or descendant tree. Unrelated summaries can be stitched into a closeout trail and pass structural checks, weakening provenance and reviewability.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary creation rejects parent/child summary links that are cross-subject, cross-tree, or cyclic unless an explicit audited migration mode is used.
Doctor validates summary graph coherence in addition to dangling summary references.
Regression tests cover cross-subject parent, cross-subject child, and cycle cases.
